newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease on correction, track Bradies.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease on correction, track Bradies.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds followed Brady bonds, easing on profit-taking in calm Friday trading.
Dealers said prices could edge down further but losses should be limited.
"Today's thin trading is rangebound, with a slow downward decline," an ICFI Moscow Partners dealer said. "The market could ease further, but nobody is seeing a big correction."
Investors were simply cashing in recent gains, he said.

MinFins set record highs earlier in the month when the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) left interest rates unchanged. Prices also rallied everyday for a week until last Wednesday, when profit-taking set in.
"Having no other clue, at least currently, MinFins are looking at Bradies," one dealer said.
Despite weakness in Brady bonds, dealers said investors in London were looking to buy into the market at the lower levels on hopes that nervousness would fade.
